# n8n_credential (Data Source)

Reads a single n8n credential by id.

The Public API returns metadata only. Secret `data` is never included. Missing ids produce an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_credential" "example" {
  id = n8n_credential.example.id
}

resource "n8n_credential" "example" {
  name              = "http-header"
  type              = "httpHeaderAuth"
  data_version      = 1
  delete_protection = false
  data = {
    name  = "X-Test"
    value = "placeholder"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Credential ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from n8n.
- `is_global` (Boolean) Whether this credential is available globally.
- `is_managed` (Boolean) Whether n8n manages this credential.
- `is_resolvable` (Boolean) Whether this credential has resolvable fields.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `resolvable_allow_fallback` (Boolean) Whether a credential resolver may fall back to static data.
- `resolver_id` (String) Dynamic credential resolver id, if any.
- `type` (String) n8n credential type name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp from n8n.
